articles.title: Toy Story 5 Breaks a Billion-Dollar Record — Three Times in a Row!
articles.summary: Buzz, Woody, and the gang just made history! Toy Story 5 zoomed past $1 billion, making it the only animated series to have three movies in a row hit that mark. That's like filling 1,000 Olympic pools with popcorn!

articles.title: Ryan Reynolds Dressed as Deadpool and Walked Around Comic-Con — and Nobody Knew!
articles.summary: Imagine meeting Deadpool at Comic-Con and then finding out it was really Ryan Reynolds! The actor snuck onto the convention floor in a gray Deadpool suit, took selfies with fans, and had zero security. He called it a 'gift.'

articles.title: A Time Capsule for America's 250th Birthday Will Stay Buried Until 2276!
articles.summary: On July 4, 2026, a super-strong time capsule will be buried in Philadelphia. It's filled with treasures from all 50 states — like a diamond, an eagle feather, and an AI prediction — and won't be opened for 250 years!
